claim: A chain of requests to an origin endpoint can include at most 2 CloudFront distributions, and exceeding this quota results in a 403 error. AWS does not recommend placing one distribution in front of another.
question: How many CloudFront distributions can sit in one chain of requests to an origin endpoint?

qualifiers.scope: per chain of requests to an origin endpoint
